# fct_training_lesson_completions

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_training_lesson_completions` · dbt area: `training`

Fact table for training lesson completions in Portal. Each row represents a single lesson completion event by an advisor. Includes context about the parent module / track content, as well as ratings and date diff metrics. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `lesson_completion_id` | Primary Key. Unique identifier for each lesson completion event. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. The advisor who completed the lesson (user_id from portal). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `completed_at` | When the advisor completed the lesson. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_activated_to_lesson_completed` | Calendar days between advisor's first booking (activation) and lesson completion. NULL if advisor never activated. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_signup_to_lesson_completed` | Calendar days between advisor signup and lesson completion. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `lesson_complete_time_minutes` | The estimated total time to complete the lesson (in minutes), as displayed to advisors. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `lesson_description` | Description of the lesson and its content. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `lesson_id` | Foreign Key. The lesson that was completed. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `lesson_name` | Display name of the lesson. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `lesson_sequence` | Display order of the lesson within its module. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `lesson_type` | The type of lesson content (e.g., webinar, video, article). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `module_id` | Foreign Key. The ID of the module the lesson belongs to. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `module_name` | Display name of the parent module. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `rating` | Advisor's rating of the lesson, provided via lesson feedback widget. NULL if no feedback given. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `track_id` | Foreign Key. The track the module belongs to. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `track_name` | Display name of the parent track. >> SOURCE - Portal |
